title: A batch OS call's error that names no item must not decide the outcome of every item
rule: When one OS call registers or unregisters many items (CTFontManagerRegisterFontsForURLs, a batched registry write) and returns an error that does not name the items it is about, do not mark every item failed and drop its ownership record: the call may have done the work for some. Mark those items unsettled, ask again one item at a time, and keep the app's record (ledger entry, activation row) of any item that may be registered, so cleanup and deactivate can still remove it (rule 3). Test it with a fake whose batch call fails without naming an item it did register, and one it did not.
rationale: E6.6 (#79): the macOS batch registration gave an unattributed CFError to every path; the activator then removed the ledger entries of fonts CoreText had registered, leaving registrations the app could no longer see or remove.
